briefdescription.para: Heading-aware Markdown chunk splitter for the LLM Wiki index.

detaileddescription.para:
Implements WikiChunkSplitter::split() using a two-pass line scan:
Lines are accumulated under the current section heading.
When a section boundary is detected the buffer is flushed via flushSection(), which applies a sliding-window split with overlap.
Chunk IDs are stable within a process run: they are derived from a FNV-1a 64-bit hash of (file_path + ":" + section_title + ":" + seq).
